title: AI Team Headshots for Your About Page | AIVideosUGC
description: Make AI team headshots with the same light and backdrop for everyone. Each person uploads their own photo, so your About page looks tidy. Start with yours.
h1: AI Team Headshots That Match, from Founder to New Hire
lead: Give everyone on your team a polished headshot in the same bright office setting, each one made from that person's own photo.
intro: The example shows a smiling team member in a black blazer, framed from the chest up in a bright office with a plant and soft daylight behind her.

Small shops often have a Team or About page with photos taken years apart in different rooms. Matching headshots make that page look tidy and help customers put a face to the people who pack their orders and answer their emails. Use one setting description for everyone, and have each person upload a recent photo of themselves.
tip: Ask each person for a front-facing photo in daylight with nothing covering their face, and paste the same setting description for every headshot.

steps.t: Collect a photo from each person
steps.d: Everyone sends a recent, well-lit photo of their own face and shoulders, without sunglasses or hats.
Describe the backdrop and outfit style once, such as "bright office, soft daylight, dark blazer," and reuse it.

steps.t: Line them up on your page
steps.d: Download each headshot and place them side by side on your About or Team page to see how they sit together.

ideas.d: A row of matching portraits on your About page, so the whole crew looks like part of one shop.
Add a friendly face beside help desk replies or in your email signature.
Use a founder headshot for your Etsy shop profile or the About section of your Shopify store.

faq.q: Can I make headshots of my team from photos I already have?
faq.a: Each headshot should come from that person's own photo, shared by them and used with their agreement. Requests involving celebrities or public figures may be declined.

faq.q: Will the headshot still look like me?
faq.a: It starts from your photo, so a clear, recent, front-facing shot gives the closest likeness. If something looks off, try again with a better-lit photo.

faq.q: Are our team photos kept private?
faq.a: Yes. The photos your team uploads and the headshots you get back are kept in your account, not posted anywhere public.
